class Course < ApplicationRecord
  include CourseModel::CourseDefinitionUpdateValidations
  include CourseModel::ForumMethods

  has_many :buildpacks
  has_many :definition_updates, class_name: "CourseDefinitionUpdate"

  has_many :language_configurations, class_name: "CourseLanguageConfiguration"
  has_many :participations, class_name: "CourseParticipation"
  has_many :repositories
  has_many :stages, class_name: "CourseStage"
  has_many :tester_versions, class_name: "CourseTesterVersion"

  validates_inclusion_of :release_status, in: %w[alpha beta live]

  validates_presence_of :sample_extension_idea_title, unless: :alpha?
  validates_presence_of :sample_extension_idea_description, unless: :alpha?

  validates_inclusion_of :difficulty, in: %w[easy medium hard]

  validates_uniqueness_of :slug

  scope :beta_or_live, -> { where(release_status: %w[beta live]) }

  AUTHOR_COURSE_SLUGS_MAP = {
    "sarp" => %w[bittorrent],
    "vic-ma" => BackendInstance.staging? ? %w[writers-stg] : %w[]
  }

  # Creates a new course that can be further updated via CourseDefinitionUpdates
  def self.create_new!(slug)
    Course.create!(slug: slug, release_status: "alpha", name: "TODO")
  end

  def self.find_by_definition_repository_name(definition_repository_name)
    repository_name_without_owner = definition_repository_name.split("/").last
    course_slug = repository_name_without_owner.gsub(/^build-your-own-/, "")
    Course.find_by(slug: course_slug)
  end

  def active_tester_version
    tester_versions.detect(&:active?)
  end

  def admin_logo_file_path
    if File.exist?(Rails.root.join("app/assets/images/challenge-logos/challenge-logo-#{slug}.svg"))
      "challenge-logos/challenge-logo-#{slug}.svg"
    else
      "challenge-logos/challenge-logo-grep.svg"
    end
  end

  def alpha?
    release_status.eql?("alpha")
  end

  def author
    AUTHOR_COURSE_SLUGS_MAP.each do |author, course_slugs|
      return User.find_by(username: author) if course_slugs.include?(slug)
    end

    nil
  end

  def base_stages
    stages.select(&:base?)
  end

  def beta?
    release_status.eql?("beta")
  end

  def definition_repository
    CourseDefinitionRepository.new(self)
  end

  def discord_debugging_help_channel
    "#debugging-help-#{slug}"
  end

  def first_stage
    sorted_base_stages.first
  end

  def free?
    is_free_until.present? && Date.current < is_free_until
  end

  def languages
    language_configurations.map(&:language)
  end

  def last_applied_definition_update
    definition_updates.where(status: :applied).order(applied_at: :desc).first
  end

  def last_stage
    sorted_stages.last
  end

  def latest_buildpack_for(language)
    buildpacks.select(&:latest?).detect { |buildpack| buildpack.language.eql?(language) }
  end

  def latest_tester_version
    tester_versions.detect(&:latest?)
  end

  def overview_url
    "#{ENV["FRONTEND_URL"]}/courses/#{slug}/overview"
  end

  def pending_definition_update
    definition_updates.pending.first
  end

  def recent_submissions
    Submission
      .joins(repository: [:course])
      .where({courses: {id: id}})
      .order(created_at: :desc)
      .limit(100)
  end

  def second_stage
    sorted_stages.second
  end

  def short_description
    # TODO: Rename the short_description_markdown column to short_description
    short_description_markdown
  end

  def sort_position_for_track
    {
      redis: 1,
      docker: 2,
      git: 3,
      sqlite: 4
    }[slug.to_sym] || 5
  end

  def sorted_base_stages
    base_stages.sort_by(&:position)
  end

  # TODO[Extensions]: Remove this? Doesn't make sense to "sort" stages when extensions are branchable
  def sorted_stages
    stages.sort_by(&:position)
  end

  def supported_language_ids
    language_configurations.pluck(:language_id)
  end

  def supports_language?(language)
    languages.include?(language)
  end

  def tester_repository_full_name
    "codecrafters-io/#{slug}-tester"
  end

  def tester_repository_name_without_owner
    tester_repository_full_name.split("/").last
  end

  def tester_repository_owner
    tester_repository_full_name.split("/").first
  end

  def third_stage
    sorted_stages.third
  end

  def url
    "#{ENV["FRONTEND_URL"]}/courses/#{slug}"
  end
end

def base_stages

     - `.select(&:base?)` applies a filter to this collection.
       - The `select` method is an enumerable method that iterates over the collection and selects those elements for which the block returns `true`.
       - `&:base?` is a shorthand for `{ |stage| stage.base? }`.
       - This means it calls the `base?` method on each `stage` object in the `stages` collection. Only those stages for which `base?` returns `true` are selected and included in the result.

4. **Return:**
   - The method returns an array of `stages` where the `base?` method returns `true`.

### Assumptions
